facts.fact: Kenya, South Sudan, Uganda and Rwanda (the last represented by a Ministry of ICT official) were reported on 2026-05-04 to have resolved at a meeting in Nairobi to work towards the design and launch of a jointly owned regional communication and broadcasting satellite (NCRCBSI), starting with a feasibility study funded by the four states; no building is reported.
facts.system: Northern Corridor Regional Communication and Broadcasting Satellite Initiative (NCRCBSI)
